description: This Java class models a product relationship entity in an e-commerce system, defining relationships between products such as related items, including metadata such as activity status, associated store, and relationship codes.

classes.name: ProductRelationship
classes.description: Entity class representing a relationship between two products, with metadata such as active status, store association, and a relationship code.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with this relationship.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the primary product for this relationship.

methods.name: getRelatedProduct
methods.description: Returns the related product in this relationship.

methods.name: setRelatedProduct
methods.description: Sets the related product for this relationship.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the relationship code or label.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if this relationship is active.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this relationship.

methods.name: setStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this relationship.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this relationship entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this relationship entity.
